description: Take-home pay for an employee in Indonesia from a gross yearly salary in IDR, with 2026 rules: every tax and contribution itemised with its local name, the effective and marginal rate, employer cost and the step-by-step workings. Covers: PPh 21 annual brackets (5-35%); Biaya jabatan, deductible JHT and JP; PTKP by marital status and dependants, combined spouse income; BPJS employee and employer contributions with caps.

combine_spouse.description: Spouse's income is combined with yours. Only when the wife has no separate NPWP; PTKP then adds 54 million. Default false.

fx_per_eur.description: Exchange rate: 1 euro = this many IDR, for the euro amounts. Default 17000 (indicative).

gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in IDR, without bonus

married.description: Married or registered partner. Default false.

spouse_income.description: Partner's gross yearly income in IDR, for joint taxation and spouse allowances. Default 0.

name: net_salary
title: Net salary in Indonesia (2026)
